variables.name: X_OAUTH_CONSUMER_KEY
variables.title: X API Key (Consumer Key)
variables.description: API Key under 'Consumer Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

variables.name: X_OAUTH_CONSUMER_SECRET
variables.title: X API Key Secret (Consumer Secret)
variables.description: API Key Secret under 'Consumer Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

variables.name: X_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.title: X Access Token (Optional — leave blank to authorize in browser)
variables.description: Access Token with Read and Write permissions under 'Authentication Tokens' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

variables.name: X_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
variables.title: X Access Token Secret (Optional — leave blank to authorize in browser)
variables.description: Access Token Secret with Read and Write permissions under 'Authentication Tokens' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.
